read.title: Great Meeting You at the Beauty Expo
read.text:
Dear Mr. Novak,

It was a pleasure meeting you at our booth at the Beauty Expo in Las Vegas last week. Thank you for taking the time to try our cica cream and toner pads.

As discussed, I'd like to follow up on your interest in becoming our distributor in Central Europe. At this stage, we are open to an exclusive agreement for a two-year term, provided that the first-year sales target is met.

I have attached our catalog and wholesale price list. Would you be available for a video call next Tuesday to discuss the details?

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.en: Write a follow-up email to a buyer you met at a trade show, mention the attached catalog, and suggest a next meeting.
hints: It was a pleasure meeting you at ...
I'd like to follow up on ...
write.model:
Dear Ms. Silva,

It was a pleasure meeting you at our booth in Las Vegas. I'd like to follow up on your interest in our sheet mask line. I have attached our catalog and price list for your review. If you are interested in becoming our distributor in Brazil, could we have a video call next week?

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
